title: ADC DC Measurement
text: Measure DC performance metrics of ADC output, 4 inputs; {Input range (V)} sets the dynamic range of ADC, {Hold off time (s)} sets the delays measurement analysis to avoid corruption, {Number of bits} sets the number of physical bits in ADC, {Start conversion frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency of the start conversion clock of ADC, {Recommended min. simulation stop time (s)} sets the minimum time simulation must run for meaningful result, {Set as model stop time} sets the automatically set recommended min. simulation stop time as model stop time, {Endpoint} sets the measure DNL, INL using endpoint method, {Best fit} sets the measure DNL, INL using best fit method, {Output result to base workspace} sets the store detailed test results to base, {Workspace variable name} sets the name of the variable that stores detailed test results and {Plot}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: analog
ports.summary: Analog input signal to ADC scalar

ports.name: digital
ports.summary: Converted digital signal from ADC scalar

ports.name: ready
ports.summary: Indicates whether analog to digital conversion is complete scalar

params.name: Hold off time (s)
params.values: Delays measurement analysis to avoid corruption by transients 0 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Number of bits
params.values: Number of physical bits in ADC 5 (default) | positive real integer

params.name: Start conversion frequency (Hz)
params.values: Frequency of the start conversion clock of ADC 10e6 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Recommended min. simulation stop time (s)
params.values: Minimum time simulation must run for meaningful result 3.2e-5 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Set as model stop time
params.values: Automatically set recommended min. simulation stop time as model stop time button

params.name: Endpoint
params.values: Measure DNL, INL using endpoint method on (default) | off

params.name: Best fit
params.values: Measure DNL, INL using best fit method on (default) | off

params.name: Output result to base workspace
params.values: Store detailed test results to base workspace off (default) | on

params.name: Workspace variable name
params.values: Name of the variable that stores detailed test results adc_dc_out (default) | character string
